# Issue

**Title:** Autogenerated documentation for deploying on github pages

## Description

I noticed there's no documentation and was wondering if it'd be helpful to have a first basic pass. I put together something with mkdocs and mkdocstrings and finally mkdocs-api-autonav.

It can be deployed using `mkdocs gh-deploy`.

For now I put a copy up at:
https://nrobot.dev/medspacy_docs/

I haven't checked for cleanliness of the code (e.g. the `site_url` would need to be changed), this is mostly to open a conversation / see if it's of interest. Thanks!

## Task

Modify the repository so that the issue described above is resolved. The repository is checked out at base commit `c9f7781f8825`. Edit files in place; the verifier captures your changes via `git diff` and scores them against an oracle patch using SWE-RL-style diff-similarity reward.
